mostWorthwhile.text: Building the printing press was most worthwhile: its explanation made the screw-and-plate mechanism clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the ink was a straightforward preparation rather than an especially interesting decision.

surprise.text: The press explanation clarified how the iron screw lowers a plate onto the inked block.

arbitrary.text: Paper and planks remained an offered combination, but its purpose was unclear; I did not try it.

continue.text: Yes. The connection between making the press and using it to spread words made me curious about what the settlement might build next.
